newsitem.title: USA: FMR group cuts Electronic Retailing stake.
newsitem.headline: FMR group cuts Electronic Retailing stake.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said Friday it cut its stake in Electronic Retailing Systems International Inc to 2,099,000 common shares or 10.08 percent from 18.73 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 120,000 common shares between August 5 and August 9 at prices ranging from $2.61 to $2.66 per share.
FMR Corp is the parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
At midday, Electronic Retailing's shares were off 3/8 to 3-5/8.
